name: 01_spawn_approach
desc: Player spawn POV approaching the compound gate. Judges: composition, golden-hour lighting, haze, world detail.

name: 02_courtyard
desc: Inside the compound. Judges: material quality, clutter, shadows, AO.

name: 03_wide_high
desc: Elevated wide of the compound. Judges: layout readability, scale, sky, horizon.

name: 04_combat_hipfire
desc: Hip-fire combat frame. Judges: viewmodel, muzzle flash, tracer, enemy presence, HUD.

name: 05_ads_engagement
desc: ADS engagement. Judges: sight alignment, FOV transition, enemy readability at range.

name: 06_explosion
desc: Explosion mid-bloom. Judges: fireball, smoke, light response, shockwave, debris.

name: 07_soldier_closeup
desc: Close-up of an enemy soldier. Judges: silhouette, camo material, kit detail, pose.

name: 08_reload
desc: Mid-reload viewmodel. Judges: animation believability, gun material close-up.

name: 09_interior
desc: Main building interior if enterable. Judges: light shafts, interior AO, prop dressing.

name: 10_sunset_silhouette
desc: Looking toward the sun across the compound. Judges: sky, bloom, silhouette, atmosphere.
